title: Microsoft Teams: Annotations on Teams Single Window Sharing on Windows OS
description: Presenters can now share a single application window and enable participants to annotate directly on top of that content, without exposing their entire desktop. This means cleaner presentations, protected privacy, and more engaging discussions across training sessions, workshops, and client meetings.
